- **Round 2 at `4970878`** (whole branch, re-review rules): correctness, simplicity and codex cold each returned NO FINDINGS.
- **Round 3 at `934f4fc`**: no findings. The branch was rebased onto main (`6b44aec`, DS-323), which moves the head. The patches are unchanged (`git range-diff` shows `=` for both), and a rebase gets a full round, so the finders read the whole branch, `origin/main...HEAD`. PR #282 → main · round 4 · 2 files · LOW tier · 1 finder (correctness) + Bea + simplicity + codex cold
bar: default@e633abb (skills/desk-review/references/review-bar.md) · domain: none · cross-vendor: codex refuted 2 Claude findings, Claude refuted 1 codex finding

The branch was rebased onto main (`fabe6ca`) after the round-3 verdict at `934f4fc`. `git range-diff` shows the PR's patches unchanged apart from the conflict-resolved import line, and a rebase gets a full round, so every seat read the whole branch (`origin/main...e633abb`), not only the range the header names. They also read what main changed underneath since `934f4fc` (`git diff 934f4fc e633abb -- desk/bin/desk-q.mjs desk/bin/cost-cache.mjs`, DS-325). Re-review rules applied: rounds 1 to 3 settled, no new P2s.

The merged import line at `desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:48` is correct: `forCosts`, `fullMonth` and `prevMonth` are all exported by `cost-cache.mjs` and all used.

### P0 (1)

**`desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:1215`: the supplier screen reads the raw cache, so its AWS charge disagrees with the repo screen's AWS row after DS-325** (found independently by correctness, simplicity and codex cold; confirmed cross-vendor both ways)

Main's DS-325 routes every charge read through `forCosts(cache, costs)`, which drops AWS profiles that costs.md no longer lists and recounts `aws.names` (`desk/bin/cost-cache.mjs:612-618`). Both existing callers use it: `desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:1074` and `supplierParts` at `:1144`. The PR's `supplierPageParts`, written before DS-325, still calls `chargesByName({ cache, names: [name] })` on the unfiltered `readCache()` (its only caller, `:2451`, passes only `{ now }`). So with a profile removed from costs.md but still in the cache, the repo screen's AWS row leaves it out and the AWS supplier screen opened from that row counts it back in. Codex reproduced it read-only: a kept $10 profile and a removed $20 one give $10 on the repo screen and $30 on the supplier screen. The removed profile also still feeds `x.credits` and the stale-read tag via `supplierTag` (`:1221`), while the line's ` · account …` list (`:1219-1220`) comes from costs.md, so the line names one set of accounts and sums another. Bar class: Money, two code paths computing the same amount differently. DS-325 AC3 (`tests/test_cost_cache_aws.mjs:267`) asserts the removed profile is in no total. GitHub and Vercel figures are unaffected, since `forCosts` touches only `aws`.

Suggested fix: in `supplierPageParts`, compute `forCosts(cache, costs)` once and pass it to `chargesByName` (`:1215`) and to `githubParts` (`:1224`), as `supplierParts` does. Add a costs-suite case where the cache holds an AWS profile costs.md has dropped, asserting the AWS supplier screen's charged figure equals the repo screen's AWS row.

<details><summary>Refutation</summary>

- Correctness's finding → codex: CONFIRMED, "supplierPageParts uses raw readCache() data, so chargesByName includes removed AWS profiles' totals and credits, while supplierParts filters them through forCosts".
- Simplicity's finding (same position) → codex: CONFIRMED. Merged into the above.
- Codex's cold finding (same position) → Claude (ada-devils-advocate): CONFIRMED at P0, citing `desk-q.mjs:1215`, `:2451`, `:1074`, `:1144`, `cost-cache.mjs:467-469`, `:537-561`, `:612-618`. Merged into the above.
</details>

### Requirements (DS-293)

No open gaps posted, nothing out of scope. Every criterion has a matching check in `tests/test_desk_q_costs.mjs`.

Caveats: no domain experts configured. No automated-reviewer inline comments on the PR to overlap with.

bar: default@3cdbb0d (`skills/desk-review/references/review-bar.md`) · finders on their default model (no finder model is set in §3b)

**This round:** `3cdbb0d` merges `origin/main` (4269d78) into the branch to clear the conflict in `desk/bin/desk-q.mjs`. The one hand-resolved hunk is in the import block. It keeps main's new `import { limitName } from './usage-limit.mjs'` and main's removal of `newestUsage` from the `usage-pace.mjs` import. It also keeps this branch's `fullMonth, prevMonth` on the `cost-cache.mjs` import. Every other file merged without a conflict.

**Seats:** one Claude correctness finder (general-purpose) and codex, each reading the merge resolution cold. Both returned NO FINDINGS. They found that every imported symbol is exported where it is imported from: `limitName` at `desk/bin/usage-limit.mjs:62`, `fullMonth`/`prevMonth` at `desk/bin/cost-cache.mjs:36-37`. `newestUsage` is left only in a comment, at `desk/bin/desk-q.mjs:1321`. Every line of main's own change is in the merged file. The requirements seat was not re-run: a merge from main changes nothing about this ticket's scope, and round 5 found no gaps at `cee3250`.

**Verification:** `with-lock.sh test bash tests/run.sh test_desk_q.mjs test_desk_q_eta.mjs` at `3cdbb0d`. The desk-q suite passed all 404 checks. The eta suite passed 121 and failed one: AC2, where `gh pr list --repo` names `bigbenjoman/desk-skills` instead of the fixture's `acme/widgets`. That comes from the worker's environment. `ghRepo()` resolves `currentRepo()` from the checkout before `DESK_GH_REPO`, and this branch touches neither the suite nor `desk-q-eta.mjs`/`desk-env.mjs`. CI on main is green. The configured related-tests row, which uses `bash -c` with `$( )`, is refused to workers, so I named the two suites directly.

**P0** This reads the raw cache. Since the rebase onto DS-325, `supplierParts` (`:1144`) and `:1074` pass `forCosts(cache, costs)`, which drops AWS profiles no longer in costs.md. So an AWS profile removed from costs.md but still cached is left out of the repo screen's AWS row and counted here, in the charged line, credits and tag (codex repro: $10 vs $30). Pass `forCosts(cache, costs)` here and to `githubParts` at `:1224`. Details in the review body.
